name: mf-storefront-demo
description: Demo playground for @mf-toolkit/shared-inspector: a React 18 e-commerce microfrontend setup with healthy, configuration-drift, federation-conflict, critical, MF 2.0 manifest, runtime bridge, and SSR scenarios.

paragraphs: Tracks @mf-toolkit/shared-inspector ^0.6.0. v0.6.0 adds a deep-import bypass detector (subpath imports of shared packages, e.g. react-dom/client), MF 2.0 mf-manifest.json ingestion, and an extended singleton-risk list (zustand, jotai, recoil, react-redux, @tanstack/react-query, swr, @apollo/client, urql). Scenarios 1, 5 and 6 — fully aligned at 0.5.x — now surface a real React 18 / SSR / runtime-library deep-import concern that 0.5.x couldn't see. The "healthy" baselines in this demo are deliberately not further refactored: the new finding is the new feature working as designed.

A demonstration repository for @mf-toolkit. Six real-world microfrontend scenarios — healthy, drifted, federation-broken, critically misconfigured, a runtime integration via @mf-toolkit/mf-bridge, and an SSR integration via @mf-toolkit/mf-ssr — all in one branch, runnable with a single command.
